title: Violin
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <g transform='rotate(-20 50 50)'>
    <!-- neck -->
    <rect x='45' y='10' width='10' height='34' rx='3' fill='#8B4513'/>
    <!-- fingerboard highlight -->
    <rect x='46' y='11' width='3' height='32' rx='2' fill='#A0522D'/>
    <!-- pegbox -->
    <rect x='44' y='4' width='12' height='8' rx='2' fill='#6B3410'/>
    <!-- pegs -->
    <rect x='38' y='5.5' width='7' height='2.5' rx='1' fill='#C8A15A'/>
    <rect x='38' y='9' width='7' height='2.5' rx='1' fill='#C8A15A'/>
    <rect x='55' y='5.5' width='7' height='2.5' rx='1' fill='#C8A15A'/>
    <rect x='55' y='9' width='7' height='2.5' rx='1' fill='#C8A15A'/>
    <!-- body -->
    <path d='M50 44
             C37 44 30 52 30 61
             C30 70 37 76 44 80
             C46 84 46 88 50 90
             C54 88 54 84 56 80
             C63 76 70 70 70 61
             C70 52 63 44 50 44 Z'
          fill='#E08A2E'/>
    <!-- body edge lighter -->
    <path d='M50 47
             C40 47 34 54 34 61
             C34 68 40 73 46 77
             C48 80 48 84 50 86
             C52 84 52 80 54 77
             C60 73 66 68 66 61
             C66 54 60 47 50 47 Z'
          fill='#F2A94E'/>
    <!-- f-holes -->
    <path d='M41 58 C40 63 42 67 41 71' stroke='#6B3410' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <path d='M59 58 C60 63 58 67 59 71' stroke='#6B3410' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <!-- bridge -->
    <rect x='44' y='63' width='12' height='2.5' rx='1' fill='#8B4513'/>
    <!-- tailpiece -->
    <path d='M46 76 L54 76 L53 86 L47 86 Z' fill='#5A2D0C'/>
    <!-- strings -->
    <line x1='47.5' y1='8' x2='47' y2='76' stroke='#F0E0C0' stroke-width='0.8'/>
    <line x1='49' y1='8' x2='48.7' y2='76' stroke='#F0E0C0' stroke-width='0.8'/>
    <line x1='51' y1='8' x2='51.3' y2='76' stroke='#F0E0C0' stroke-width='0.8'/>
    <line x1='52.5' y1='8' x2='53' y2='76' stroke='#F0E0C0' stroke-width='0.8'/>
    <!-- chinrest -->
    <ellipse cx='60' cy='80' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#4A2510'/>
    <!-- scroll -->
    <circle cx='50' cy='4' r='4' fill='#6B3410'/>
    <circle cx='50' cy='4' r='1.6' fill='#8B4513'/>
    <!-- bow -->
    <line x1='82' y1='20' x2='74' y2='86' stroke='#C8A15A' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='80' y1='22' x2='73' y2='82' stroke='#F0E0C0' stroke-width='0.9'/>
  </g>
</svg>
